summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 3D glass-label overlay feature and immediate regressions on the premium residential website. Verified all 10 scenarios from the review request across Nest (2 units), Ivy (1 unit), Skylark (3 units), the projects card teaser, mobile viewport (390x844), and general regressions. Every assertion passed — no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanLabels.jsx & FloorPlanViewer.jsx are clean, small, use env-based routing correctly. No _id or hardcoded URLs. data-testids well distributed.

Minor nit (not blocking): viewer-3d-labels-layer uses imgBox measured on onLoad+resize; if the image element changes size due to CSS media queries below common breakpoints, layer may briefly desync until next resize event. Currently works fine in tested viewports (1920 and 390).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3D glass-label overlay feature fully verified. Key testids in use: plan-3d-button, plan-2d-button, plan-3d-image, plan-3d-label-overlay, plan-3d-label-{i}, plan-unit-bar, room-unit-tab-{i}, plan-unit-area, plan-unit-label (single-unit projects), floor-plan-preview, floor-plan-viewer, viewer-3d-labels-layer, viewer-3d-label-{i}, viewer-unit-bar, viewer-unit-tab-{i}, viewer-unit-area, viewer-zoom-in/out/reset/close, card-3d-chip-{slug}. Old room-details testid confirmed absent. Escape key close works reliably (needed ~800ms wait; 500ms was marginal in one run).

verified_scenarios.viewer_full_screen: PASS — labels visible, unit bar with tabs, zoom-in twice → 169%, reset → 100%, tab switch inside viewer changes labels & area (2 BHK · Saleable Area 1250 SFT), Escape and close button both close
verified_scenarios.state_sync: PASS — selecting 2 BHK in plan sheet then opening viewer shows 2 BHK active; changing unit in viewer also reflects in plan sheet after close
